title: The Big Picture
description: A simple modpack that bridges betwen Create and it Addons with beautiful terrain and structure generation with great performance with shaders
body:
Welcome!
This is a simple modpack for 1.21.1 NeoForge. It’s built around exploration, airships, and smooth performance.

Main Mods:
Distant Horizons (for insane render distances)

Create + Create: Aeronautics (build working airships and factories)

Tectonic + Biomes O' Plenty + Dungeons and Taverns (massive world gen and structures to explore)

Performance & QoL:
It is fully optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix, so it runs great even with shaders turned on. It also includes a bunch of basic QoL tweaks for maps, inventory sorting, and UI.

Multiplayer:
It has e4mc built-in, so you can host a world and invite your friends to play instantly without needing a dedicated server.
